text: So with Neurological De-Armoring, I'm fixing the underpinnings first, instead of redecorating. I use Ketones (BHB), which block HDAC (an enzyme that keeps genes switched off), along with Glutamate modulation, and together they work like a metabolic solvent to soften the "concrete" in the brainstem. That lets us dig under the house and pour a new foundation, so we can then update the psychological software upstairs.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware.
reader: someone with trauma, often with addiction, who has done therapy and still reacts the same way, reading to learn why and whether this protocol is for them
